title: The Burning Choir Anew
author: Bram Winterbourne
blurb: August Kavanagh, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
